title: Visual Transformer and Deep CNN Prediction of High-risk COVID-19 Infected Patients using Fusion of CT Images and Clinical Data
summary: A 3D Swin Transformer fused 64-section CT scans with clinical admission data to classify high-risk COVID-19 outcome among 380 diagnosed inpatients. Five-fold validation compared CT-only, clinical-only and fused models; fusion improved performance, with reported TPR 0.95, FPR 0.40 and AUC 0.77. Retrospective single-hospital data and false positives limit clinical claims.
